mapper.sql: id, org_id, request_type, status, channel, requester_name, subject_name, subject_email, subject_workspace_id, subject_person_id, received_at, identity_verified_at, due_at, responded_at, closed_at, summary, resolution, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_subject_request (org_id, request_type, status, channel, requester_name, subject_name, subject_email, subject_workspace_id, subject_person_id, received_at, identity_verified_at, due_at, responded_at, closed_at, summary, resolution, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{requestType}, #{status}, #{channel}, #{requesterName}, #{subjectName}, #{subjectEmail}, #{subjectWorkspaceId}, #{subjectPersonId}, COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{identityVerifiedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{respondedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{summary}, #{resolution}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE data_subject_request SET request_type = #{requestType}, status = #{status}, channel = #{channel}, requester_name = #{requesterName}, subject_name = #{subjectName}, subject_email = #{subjectEmail}, subject_workspace_id = #{subjectWorkspaceId}, subject_person_id = #{subjectPersonId}, received_at = COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, received_at), identity_verified_at = #{identityVerifiedAt}, due_at = #{dueAt}, responded_at = #{respondedAt}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, summary = #{summary}, resolution = #{resolution}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND org_id = #{orgId}
